items.a: Current and former faculty of IISER Bhopal, students and alumni of IISER Bhopal, partner universities that have an R&D collaboration with IISER Bhopal, and startups from outside IISER Bhopal. Partner universities and outside startups need an IISER Bhopal faculty member as mentor or collaborator.

items.q: Can a startup from outside IISER Bhopal apply?
items.a: Yes. IICE is open to incubating external entrepreneurs. The application must be supported by an IISER Bhopal faculty member as mentor or collaborator.

The proposal should fall in one of five thrust areas: Healthcare and Bioengineering; Environment and Agriculture; Internet of Things and Artificial Intelligence; Social and Rural Development Technologies; and Computational Sciences and Information Technology.

items.q: What do I need to submit?
items.a: A formal application with a detailed proposal. The proposal should include a business plan and details of the IP or technology the company will be based on. If the technology was developed at IISER Bhopal, attach a copy of the filed or granted patent application.
